note: Small single loop on a point in the upper, Cumberland River part of Lake Barkley; sites 21, 22, 24, 26 and 27 face the water. Boat ramp and a public marina nearby. --Claude
summary: USACE Lake Barkley campground confirmed on rec.gov: 15 water+electric sites, $30 ($34 on five lakeshore sites), 14-in-30 limit, showers, dump. Lakeview -> lakefront UPGRADE CANDIDATE (sites 21/22/24/26/27). Pin ~345 m off. Phone empty -> (931) 232-8831. Electric amperage conflicting (50 vs 30) and not written.
flags: WATERFRONT lakeview -> lakefront UPGRADE CANDIDATE (stored value not --AWH): rec.gov prices sites 21, 22, 24, 26 and 27 at $34 against $30 elsewhere, and they are the shore row of the loop. Per-site coordinates and 3DEP: 22 (36.619616,-87.886176) 111.0 m with the 109.4 m summer-pool line ~14 m north; 26 (36.619439,-87.88646) 111.3 m, ~16 m NW; 21 (36.619696,-87.885814) 112.3 m, ~18 m; 24 (36.619543,-87.886324) 111.2 m, ~24 m NW - pads 1.6-2.9 m above summer pool on a gentle bank. Rec.gov's own photos show 24's pad and table ending on open grass with the lake just beyond and only scattered trunks, 26 and 27 looking to the water across open ground under scattered trees. No road or swim beach between (the beach is at the separate day-use area to the south). All are ordinary nightly reservable sites (RV max 45-75 ft). Imagery shows a fringe of crowns at the water's edge, which the ground photos show to be scattered trunks, not a screen.

PIN MOVE ~345 m: stored 36.6163,-87.8860 is in woods south of the campground, near the day-use parking/boat ramp road; the 15 sites' catalog coordinates centre on ~36.6194,-87.8861 (the loop on the point, confirmed on Esri imagery). Rec.gov's facility pin 36.618847,-87.879425 is ~600 m east and also off.
PHONE empty -> (931) 232-8831 (rec.gov: 'BUMPUS MILLS CAMPGROUND: (931) 232-8831'; resource managers office (270) 362-4236). Websites unchanged.

HOOKUPS: every catalog site carries both 'Electric Hookup' 50 and 'Electricity Hookup' 30 (the attribute recgov_hookups.py reads); stored electric 50 (derived from the old note's '30-50 amp') left as is - a human or recgov_hookups.py should settle it.
